name: k3-expressive
description: Monorepo — k3ui (Material 3 Expressive web components) + k3ux (UX companion). Each package is published on its own.

scripts.build: npm run build -w k3ui && npm run build -w k3ux
scripts.build:lazy: npm run build:lazy -w k3ui && npm run build:lazy -w k3ux
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.pack:dry: npm pack --dry-run -w k3ui && npm pack --dry-run -w k3ux
